svg.title: Centralized Logging
svg.desc: Centralized Logging. Ship structured logs from every service to one searchable store, correlated by request ID. Step 1, Scattered logs: One failed request left lines on three instances; a deployment replaces one, and its log is gone. Step 2, Structured and shipped: Services write named fields to stdout; each node's agent adds metadata and ships them to one store. Step 3, One query, one request: One search for the trace ID returns all three services' lines in time order: Payments timed out. Step 4, Affordable and safe: Drop debug lines, mask card numbers on the node, tier retention, and buffer while the store is down.

g.text: One failed request left lines on three instances; a deployment replaces one, and its log is gone.
Services write named fields to stdout; each node's agent adds metadata and ships them to one store.
One search for the trace ID returns all three services' lines in time order: Payments timed out.
Drop debug lines, mask card numbers on the node, tier retention, and buffer while the store is down.
